S40.01.note: The reply uses the nickname if set, otherwise the full name, per renderPersonalizationBlock in apps/mobile/src/features/memory/services/personalization.ts.
steps: Tap "Open menu" at the top left of a chat.
Type a name in "Nickname" (placeholder "What should AGI call you?").
Tap "Save personalization settings" (Save at the top right).
Start a new chat, ask "What is my name?" and check the reply uses that name.
S40.01.where: Open menu > Settings > Personalization (under Assistant) > Nickname

S40.02.note: The field is saved as aboutYou and sent to chat as "More about the user, in their words" in apps/mobile/src/features/memory/services/personalization.ts.
steps: Type interests, values or background into "More about you" (placeholder "Interests, values or background to keep in mind").
Start a new chat and ask for a suggestion that depends on your background, and check the reply takes it into account.
S40.02.where: Open menu > Settings > Personalization > More about you

S40.03.note: The screen field is named Occupation, not role or profession; the saved text is sent to chat as "The user works as" with "Tailor examples accordingly".
steps: Type your work into "Occupation" (placeholder "e.g. Founder & Engineer").
Start a new chat, ask for an example, and check the example fits your work.

S40.05.needs: a signed-in account and a chat
S40.05.note: Choosing Normal in the same sheet falls back to the saved style from Personalization.
steps: Open a chat or start a new one.
Tap the "+" button labelled "Add to chat" next to the message box.
Tap "Explanatory" (or another option) in the style sheet.
Send a question and check the reply follows that one style.
S40.05.where: Chat screen > Add to chat (+ button by the message box) > Choose style

steps: Start a new chat, ask a question, and compare the reply length with the choice.
S40.06.where: Open menu > Settings > Personalization > Response Length

S40.07.note: The code has no separate formality control; Formal is the Style Preset value. The quoted line in the plan no longer matches, but the chip exists.
steps: Start a new chat, ask a question, and check the reply uses a more formal register.
S40.07.where: Open menu > Settings > Personalization > Style Preset > Formal

steps: Under "Style Preset", tap one preset: Default, Concise, Explanatory, Learning or Formal.
Start a new chat, ask a question, and check the reply follows only that preset.
S40.08.where: Open menu > Settings > Personalization > Style Preset (or Chat > Add to chat > Choose style)

S40.09.note: The trait is set by Less, Default or More, not a slider.
steps: In the sheet, tap "More" (warmer) or "Less" (cooler), or "Default".
Start a new chat, ask a question, and compare the warmth of the reply.
S40.09.where: Open menu > Settings > Personalization > Response Style > Warmth

steps: Start a new chat, ask a question, and compare how energetic the reply sounds.
S40.10.where: Open menu > Settings > Personalization > Response Style > Enthusiasm

steps: Under "Response Style", tap the "Headers and lists" row.
In the sheet, tap "More" for headings and lists, or "Less" for prose.
Start a new chat, ask a question that has several parts, and check whether the reply uses headers and lists.
S40.11.where: Open menu > Settings > Personalization > Response Style > Headers and lists

steps: In the sheet, tap "Less" (no emoji) or "More".
Start a new chat, ask a question, and check whether the reply has emoji.
S40.12.where: Open menu > Settings > Personalization > Response Style > Emoji

steps: Start a new chat, ask the same technical question, and compare the depth of the reply.
S40.13.where: Open menu > Settings > Personalization > Technical Level

steps: Under "Response Language", tap a language name, or "Match my message" to keep the default.
Start a new chat, ask a question, and check the reply is written in the chosen language.
S40.14.where: Open menu > Settings > Personalization > Response Language

S40.16.note: No on/off switch for instructions was found; the only way to turn them off without the text being lost is not provided, so clearing the field deletes the text.
steps: Type standing instructions into "Custom Instructions" (placeholder "e.g. I prefer direct, technical answers...").
Tap "Save personalization settings", then start a new chat and check a reply follows them.
To switch them off, clear the "Custom Instructions" field, tap save, and check the next reply no longer follows them.
S40.16.where: Open menu > Settings > Personalization > Custom Instructions

S40.17.needs: a signed-in account and a project
S40.17.note: Project settings also has a switch, "Use your profile and instructions", in apps/mobile/src/features/projects/components/ProjectSettingsScreen.tsx that controls account instructions per project.
steps: Tap a project in the list.
Start a new chat inside that project, ask a question, and check the reply follows the project instructions.

S40.19.needs: a signed-in account and a chat
S40.19.note: The choice is saved per conversation (chatStyleByConversation in apps/mobile/stores/chat/chatViewStore.ts).
steps: Open a chat with a saved conversation.
Check the reply is short, then open Settings > Personalization and check the saved Style Preset is unchanged.
S40.19.where: Chat screen > Add to chat (+) > Choose style

S40.23.note: Reset covers style, length, technical level, language and the four Response Style levels only; name, occupation and instructions are kept.
steps: Change a few Response Style or Style Preset choices.
Check the choices return to Default, then tap "Save personalization settings" to keep them.
S40.23.where: Open menu > Settings > Personalization > Reset response style

S40.24.needs: a signed-in account and a chat
steps: Send a question and check the reply explains reasoning and context.
S40.24.where: Chat screen > Add to chat (+) > Choose style > Explanatory

S40.26.needs: a signed-in account and a chat
S40.26.note: Personalization > Style Preset also offers Concise, described as "Short, to the point" in apps/mobile/src/features/settings/personalization/constants.ts.
steps: Send a question and check the reply is short and direct.
S40.26.where: Chat screen > Add to chat (+) > Choose style > Concise
